roles.name: Product Owner
actions: create the active module's planning and new-work artifacts

roles.name: Scrum Master / Delivery Lead
actions: review the active module's open work

roles.name: Tech Lead / Architect
actions: approve rule changes and new domains
vet a development artifact's rule target(s)

roles.name: Developer
actions: create the active module's development artifacts (implementation-driven)
implement the active module's development artifacts

roles.name: QA / Tester
actions: report defects through the active module's development artifacts

roles.name: Stakeholder
actions: propose ideas and planning items to the active module
